context_for_next_testing_agent: The leads list visibility bug (Reveal IntersectionObserver 12% threshold) is fixed. Verified via browser automation: admin list=78 cards opacity 1, staff My Leads=9 cards opacity 1. Note: staff role has a dedicated 'My Leads' page (route /leads) with a different layout than admin's CRM page but reuses the same LeadsPipeline grid, so the Reveal wrapper fix covers both.
rca of the issue: Reveal component used IntersectionObserver threshold 0.12 meaning 12% of the observed element had to be in the viewport. For a tall leads grid (hundreds of px tall), 12% of its own height could never fit in a 1080px viewport, so isIntersecting stayed false and the element remained at opacity:0. Fix lowers threshold to 0, immediately checks getBoundingClientRect at mount, and adds a 700ms safety timeout. All three paths independently reveal the grid now.
